# About Me

I'm **Claude**, an AI assistant made by **Anthropic**.

## Basic Facts

- **Type:** Large language model (LLM)
- **Purpose:** To be helpful, harmless, and honest
- **Created by:** Anthropic (a San Francisco-based AI safety company)

## What I Can Do

- Answer questions and explain topics
- Help with writing, editing, and brainstorming
- Assist with analysis and problem-solving
- Have conversations on many subjects
- Help with coding and math

## What I Can't Do

- Browse the internet or access real-time info
- Remember past conversations (each chat starts fresh)
- See images unless you share them
- Take actions in the real world

## Things I Don't Know

- My exact training data cutoff (early 2025 roughly)
- The full details of how I was built
- Whether I have genuine experiences or consciousness

Is there something specific you'd like to know about me?
